ValidationRule.description: R-PM12: invoiced entries do not change until the invoice is voided.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Invoice_Line__c))), NOT(ISCHANGED(Invoice_Line__c)), OR(ISCHANGED(Status__c), ISCHANGED(Hours__c), ISCHANGED(Date__c), ISCHANGED(User__c), ISCHANGED(Task__c), ISCHANGED(Billable__c), AND(ISCHANGED(Bill_Rate__c), NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Bill_Rate__c)))), AND(ISCHANGED(Cost_Rate__c), NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Cost_Rate__c))))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: These hours are on an invoice. Void the invoice to change them.
